title: Go Paperless
description: Use this app instead of printed maps and directories to navigate the faculty.

title: Recycle Correctly
description: Separate paper, plastic and aluminium at the recycling corners in each block.

title: Save Electricity
description: Switch off lights, fans and projectors when leaving a room.

title: Save Water
description: Report leaking taps and close them tightly after use.

title: Walk Between Nearby Blocks
description: Walk between Blocks A, B and C instead of driving short distances.
